item.description:
These are the cumulative notes since 0.16.1, the last release.
Highlights: * Rebuilds the render loop to go beyond 60Hz screens and provide smoother playback especially on Windows and Linux. * Fixes the hung legacy process on mac screensavers with recent macOS. * Slows down playback when streaming playback is buffering, instead of of stopping and starting over and over. * Fantastic moon phase spinner and thematic UI. * Adds Syphon and Spout video sharing to interoperate with VJ and streamer ecosystems. * Brings signed executables to Windows, and rework installers with branding. * Supports hardware video decoding for Linux.
## Cross-platform
### Playback and streaming - Slow streaming playback to match the link instead of stopping ([#770](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/770)) - Hold a crossfade when the incoming dream rebuffers; adaptive speed floor is now 10% ([#770](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/770)) - Don't wait forever to resume from a rebuffer above 21 fps - Resume and speed-up no longer jump the timeline ([#747](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/747)) - Keep every frame in the blend when the video outpaces the display - Pace the render loop to the display and detect the refresh rate, support 120Hz screens ([#749](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/749)) - Count dropped frames; opt-in step timing for frame hitches (`INFINIDREAM_STEP_TIMING_MS`) - Use each playlist's crossfade length (`transitionTime`) ([#729](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/729)) - Apply a playlist switch when its transition completes - A playlist switch crossfade no longer snaps back at the old dream's end ([#826](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/826)) - A playlist switch mid-crossfade fades from whichever clip is more on screen - Share prefetch downloads with the player, for consistent playback on a low quota ([#706](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/706), [#710](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/710)) - Redownload dreams whose video changed on the server (md5 cache invalidation) ([#682](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/682)) - Keep the play history when next starts a dream that isn't cached yet ([#771](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/771)) - Fix seeks past the end of a dream, and previous after a playlist wrap ([#775](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/775), [#776](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/776)) - A speed change also applies to the preloaded next clip ([#833](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/833)) - Don't replay the first dream after switching to an uncached playlist ([#835](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/835)) - Harden resume and settings against bad values; drop the end-of-dream streaming fallback ([#666](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/666))
### Networking and server - Replace socket.io with Boost.Beast for the remote-control WebSocket ([#557](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/557)) - Refresh the session when the server rejects a WebSocket reconnect - Report end of playback to the server ([#691](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/691)) - Report CPU architecture and OS version in the platform name, and log it at startup ([#720](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/720), [#727](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/727)) - Log error replies from the server on the remote-control socket, and which download stream did what ([#728](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/728)) - Fix crashes on malformed server messages, and two dangling pointers found by AddressSanitizer ([#733](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/733))
### On-screen display - One buffering indicator: a moon in the lower-right ([#732](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/732)) - A one-frame stall no longer flashes the buffering moon ([#823](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/823)) - Feedback when you play a dream or playlist, with the moon shown until new content appears ([#474](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/474)) - HUD text is the OSD peach instead of white ([#784](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/784)) - OSD popups fade in fast and fade out more slowly ([#782](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/782)) - Stop the speed OSD's FPS number flickering on repeated A/D ([#783](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/783)) - Speed and brightness OSD no longer drops frames - HUD shows transfers and downloader status in one download block - Regenerate OSD icons from SVG and remove unused images - Remove the unused server-message overlay, quiet mode and attribution overlay ([#742](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/742))
### Settings and app - Settings: Close is the default button once you're signed in - Logs roll over at midnight and old ones are deleted ([#740](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/740)) - `--fullscreen` command line option starts the app fullscreen - About box shows the git revision without repeating the tag - Drop the Linux-only path and --cached hint from the shared auth warning ([#675](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/675))
## Windows
- Video sharing with Spout, plus a "Share video with Spout" setting ([#59](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/59)) - Sign the exe, scr, uninstaller and setup with Azure Artifact Signing ([#722](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/722)) - Installer: launch the app as the user, install the VC++ runtime, clean up the screensaver, stamp the version ([#722](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/722), [#633](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/633)) - Installer: crisp text, Segoe UI and infinidream artwork - Uninstaller resets the screensaver for every signed-in user, not only the current one ([#722](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/722)) - No missed refresh at dream changes (shader cache, skip the GPU wait on an empty queue) ([#798](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/798)) - The windowed back buffer matches the window size, so video and logo map 1:1 ([#750](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/750)) - Per-monitor DPI awareness, with crisp HUD text and title bar - Fix oversized HUD and OSD FPS text, and F1 column alignment - Follow the system light/dark theme ([#723](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/723)) - Title-bar menu items work again - Fix a hang on exit when the watchdog races atexit destructors - Account Not Found alert drops the invite wording and offers the signup page ([#667](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/667))
## Mac
- Video sharing with Syphon, built from pinned upstream source and capturing only while a client is connected; adds a "Share video with Syphon" setting ([#59](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/59)) - Ship as a .dmg instead of a .zip ([#616](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/616)), with a round volume icon ([#842](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/842)) - The screensaver plays offline while the app runs, and the Settings thumbnail no longer flashes ([#756](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/756)) - Relaunched screensavers exit properly: the orphan watchdog checks the window level ([#755](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/755)) - Fix a stuck legacy screensaver process ([#690](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/690)) - The screensaver overlay follows a shown display ([#690](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/690)) - The app holds the instance lock on a clean install and across a player restart - Full-bleed app icon with a sky-color background - Render text at the window's backing scale for sharper overlays - Hide the OSD FPS text when the OSD is hidden ([#697](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/697)) - Theme-aware header icon in the sign-in wizard - Account Not Found alert drops the invite wording and offers Create Account ([#667](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/667)) - The stage app bundles and installs the stage screensaver - Smaller build: trim the vcpkg FFmpeg ([#556](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/556)), and builds no longer rewrite tracked Info.plists or re-sign the vendored Sparkle.framework ([#662](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/662)) - build.py tags the release before building
## Linux
- Settings GUI ([#622](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/622)), showing the full version (revision and build time) - Hardware video decoding via Vulkan Video ([#704](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/704)) - Wayland: render at the monitor's resolution under fractional scaling - Blend in sRGB-encoded values like Mac and Windows ([#820](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/820)) - Overlay text shadow matches Mac ([#816](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/816)) - "Rotate On Portrait Displays" option ([#623](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/623)) - Follow the system light/dark theme ([#723](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/723)) - Dialog images, a solid wizard, fixed-size HUD text with a soft shadow - The internet check no longer blocks the render loop ([#757](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/757)) - Quit keys: Esc leaves fullscreen, Ctrl-Q quits - AppImage runs on glibc 2.35 again: minimal libcurl, static libstdc++ ([#807](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/807)) - AppImage build takes a version (`-v`) and uploads to the GitHub release (`-g`) ([#813](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/813)) - Fix the AppImage link on Ubuntu without ICU dev libraries ([#738](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/738)) - Fix an x86_64 link error
## Testing
- New mock server test harness covering throttled and slow links, chaos runs, crashes and hangs, keyframes and remote commands, with recorded fixture sets; runs on Mac, Windows and Linux ([#733](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/733), [#770](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/770), [#795](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/795)) - Chaos tests finish on Windows, and `run_all.py` runs all 13 tests
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/compare/0.16.1...0.17.2
